description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You draw an Overflow effect of the highest rank you can cast.

Your Reckoning does not advance for this draw. Nothing else about it changes. This is guaranteed: it cannot be prevented, spent early by another effect, or lost to any condition — if you have not used it, it is there, and the Halving does not notice it going because the Halving does not notice anything.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Reckoning not advancing for one draw -- the Reckoning (this class's own 4-stage penalty track) has zero Foundry-schema footprint: classes.reckoner.json ships "rules": [] and defines no SpecialResource, counter, or stage-tracking rule element of any kind to hook.
